---
title: Vendor Details
description: The financial summary, tabs, and shortcuts on a vendor's detail page.
---

Select **View** (eye icon) on a vendor in the Vendors list to open its detail
page.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-detail-top.jpg" alt="Vendor detail page" caption="(1) Edit, (2) Notes, (3) Activities, (4) Financial Summary." />

## Page header

| Control | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Back arrow | Returns to the Vendors list. |
| **Edit** | Edits the vendor. |
| **Notes** | Opens **Vendor Notes**. |
| **Activities** | Opens **Vendor Activities**. |

Below the header, a summary card shows the vendor's **Doing Business As
(DBA)**, **Category**, and **Branches**.

## Financial summary

The **Financial Summary** section shows **Current Month Expense**, **Lifetime
Expense**, **Outstanding Amount**, **Vendor Credit**, and **Returns**, with
**Expense Distribution** (current vs previous months) and **Bills Status**
(outstanding vs paid) charts. Use the arrow to collapse or expand it.

## Detail tabs

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-detail-tabs.jpg" alt="Vendor detail tabs" caption="The detail tabs (1). The Details tab is shown." />

| Tab | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Details** | DBA, Category, Website URL, Payment Method, Payment Term, Branches, and R2 Certified. |
| **Contacts** | The vendor's contacts. |
| **Addresses** | The vendor's addresses. Select **New Address** to add one. |
| **History** | A log of changes to the vendor. |
| **Attachments** | Files attached to the vendor. |
| **Transactions** | The vendor's **Bills**, **Bill Payments**, **Purchase Orders**, **Vendor Credits**, and **Expenses**. |

### Transactions

The **Transactions** tab lists all of the vendor's transactions in one place,
grouped by document type: **Bills**, **Bill Payments**, **Purchase Orders**,
**Vendor Credits**, and **Expenses**. For example, the **Bills** section shows
each bill's date, bill number, due date, paid amount, status, and amount. When a
section has no records, it says so — for example, *No purchase orders found for
this vendor.*

Select a document number to open the document.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-transactions.jpg" alt="Vendor Transactions tab" caption="(1) Transactions tab, (2) the vendor's bills." />

## Notes and activities

Keep internal notes and schedule activities for a vendor from **Vendors
Management → Notes** and **Vendors Management → Activites**, or use the
**Notes** and **Activities** buttons on the vendor page. See [Vendor Notes &
Activities](/docs/purchases/vendors/notes-and-activities).
